import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Student-level data
df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: School-level data
df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Merge the two dataframes on 'school_name' to bring school info into student records
df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on="school_name", how="left")

# Reorder and select columns to match the target schema exactly:
# Target Schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
#                 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']

target_columns = ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
                  'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Student ID': 'int64',
    'student_name': 'string',
    'gender': 'string',
    'grade': 'string',
    'school_name': 'string',
    'reading_score': 'int64',
    'math_score': 'int64',
    'School ID': 'int64',
    'type': 'string',
    'size': 'int64',
    'budget': 'int64'
})

# Write the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_1/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
